notes.title: Advent: Dawn DEMO out now!
notes.content:
[h3]The Advent: Dawn demo is now available for download! [/h3][p]We’re proud to announce the first playable demo of our upcoming title. The demo is about 30-minutes to complete and roughly covers the first 4-hours of the in-game journey. It introduces the characters, the setting, and ends with the climactic "inciting event".  

The demo and full release will both be [b]fully compatible with the Steam Deck[/b]. Please contact us through a community post or on Discord if you have any challenges or bugs.  

Please note this demo will only be available for the next few months. Enjoy!  

[i]-Spire Games.[/i][/p]

notes.title: 'Advent: Dawn' Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]We're finally able to announce [b]'Advent: Dawn' [/b]is our next sci-fi mystery instalment.

We expect the game to release late 2025 or early 2026. Make sure to not only wishlist, but [b][i]'follow'[/i][/b] if you'd to stay updated along the journey and be informed when we drop the release date.

Thanks for all your support! Feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/8H32pmn69s"]join us here on discord[/url] or post any questions on the community page.

Spire Games.


[/p]
